overall_goal: Unpack groceries, clean up the workspace, and prepare utensils and spices for cooking

goals.description: Unpack groceries from the tote bag
goals.rationale: The person opens the tote bag and removes various grocery items, placing them on the counter and pushing them back to make space.

goals.description: Clear items and retrieve a colander and tray
goals.rationale: The person moves a can opener to the sink, disposes of an empty can, and opens drawers to retrieve a colander and a tray.

goals.description: Clean up loose skins and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person gathers loose skins from the counter, throws them into the food waste bin, and then dries their hands with kitchen paper before throwing the paper away.

goals.description: Read the recipe, retrieve measuring spoons, and locate spices
goals.rationale: The person gets measuring spoons from a drawer, reads the recipe on a piece of paper, and then opens the spice drawer to read and locate the required spices.

goals.description: Close spice jars and sort measuring spoons
goals.rationale: The person screws the lids back onto several spice jars, sorts through measuring spoons to find the right size, and drops a used spoon into the sink.

goals.description: Return spice jars to the drawer and retrieve utensils
goals.rationale: The person finishes tightening the lids on the spice jars, carries them to the drawer to put them away, and then opens another drawer to retrieve a spatula and a wooden spoon.
